additionalScopeFindings.topic: logPlan has no runtime publication primitive beyond per-parameter results
additionalScopeFindings.fact: logPlan.rawValues / .context require the item to record applied levels, observation states, relay read-backs, I2C status, sweep step and dwell, and .judgement requires a PENDING_LIMIT_RULING marker. The only publication primitive reachable in the declared scope is CParam::SetTestResult(site, 0, value); 'LogData' occurs in test.cpp only as the 'Step 6: LogData' comment heading of sibling items and LOG() occurs only as TREG_LOG in treg.h (a Trim framework class, not an item log).
additionalScopeFindings.handling: not raised as a separate preflight requirement because the sibling items TM107-TM110 satisfy the same logPlan section with trace comments plus SetTestResult and no reviewer has rejected that form; recorded here so the implementation review can rule on it explicitly.
